items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC7 are implemented without historical compaction or changing the manual record_event CLI contract; the unchanged-grade payload now matches AC1 exactly.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Malformed entries and TypeError, ValueError, and OverflowError during numeric normalization remain non-comparable and append instead of escaping the lock or losing a snapshot.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The change introduces no credential, authorization, SQL, HTML, or network boundary and adds no secrets or executable user input.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Outcome-based tests cover append and skip paths, malformed durable data, lineage isolation, event-type opt-in, stale trees, concurrency, emitter composition, and the historical monkeypatch seam.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The reverse scan stops at the newest comparable snapshot and reuses the existing single-lock read/append path; no additional I/O pass or unbounded nested work was introduced.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Dedup predicates are cohesive in lib/event_dedup.py, compatibility wrappers preserve established names, and record_event.py is reduced to 757 lines below its 769-line ADR-111 baseline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer and consumers of shipwright_events.jsonl are enumerated; write-read, emitter-composition, malformed-line, and lock-scoped round-trip probes pass while the serialized event shape remains unchanged.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff completed with no findings.
